verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.233
verses.english: Linked Discourses 35.233

verses.pali: 18. Samuddavagga
verses.english: 18. The Ocean

verses.pali: Kāmabhūsutta
verses.english: With Kāmabhū

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ca ānando āyasmā ca kāmabhū kosambiyaṁ viharanti ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time the venerables Ānanda and Kāmabhū were staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā kāmabhū sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then in the late afternoon, Venerable Kāmabhū came out of retreat, went to Venerable Ānanda, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā kāmabhū āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to Ānanda:

verses.pali: “Kiṁ nu kho, āvuso ānanda, cakkhu rūpānaṁ saṁyojanaṁ, rūpā cakkhussa saṁyojanaṁ …pe…
verses.english: “Reverend Ānanda, which is it? Is the eye the fetter of sights, or are sights the fetter of the eye?

verses.pali: jivhā rasānaṁ saṁyojanaṁ, rasā jivhāya saṁyojanaṁ …pe…
verses.english: Is the ear … nose … tongue … body …

verses.pali: mano dhammānaṁ saṁyojanaṁ, dhammā manassa saṁyojanan”ti?
verses.english: mind the fetter of ideas, or are ideas the fetter of the mind?”

verses.pali: “Na kho, āvuso kāmabhū, cakkhu rūpānaṁ saṁyojanaṁ, na rūpā cakkhussa saṁyojanaṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend Kāmabhū, the eye is not the fetter of sights, nor are sights the fetter of the eye.

verses.pali: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṁ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṁ tattha saṁyojanaṁ …pe…
verses.english: The fetter there is the desire and greed that arises from the pair of them.

verses.pali: na jivhā rasānaṁ saṁyojanaṁ, na rasā jivhāya saṁyojanaṁ …pe…
verses.english: The ear … nose … tongue … body …

verses.pali: na mano dhammānaṁ saṁyojanaṁ, na dhammā manassa saṁyojanaṁ.
verses.english: mind is not the fetter of ideas, nor are ideas the fetter of the mind.

verses.pali: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṁ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṁ tattha saṁyojanaṁ.
verses.english: The fetter there is the desire and greed that arises from the pair of them.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, kāḷo ca balībaddo odāto ca balībaddo ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṁyuttā assu.
verses.english: Suppose there was a black ox and a white ox yoked by a single harness or yoke.

verses.pali: Yo nu kho evaṁ vadeyya:
verses.english: Would it be right to say that

verses.pali: ‘kāḷo balībaddo odātassa balībaddassa saṁyojanaṁ, odāto balībaddo kāḷassa balībaddassa saṁyojanan’ti, sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
verses.english: the black ox is the yoke of the white ox, or the white ox is the yoke of the black ox?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, āvuso”.
verses.english: “No, reverend.

verses.pali: “Na kho, āvuso, kāḷo balībaddo odātassa balībaddassa saṁyojanaṁ, napi odāto balībaddo kāḷassa balībaddassa saṁyojanaṁ.
verses.english: The black ox is not the yoke of the white ox, nor is the white ox the yoke of the black ox.

verses.pali: Yena ca kho te ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṁyuttā, taṁ tattha saṁyojanaṁ.
verses.english: The yoke there is the single harness or yoke that they’re yoked by.”

verses.pali: Evameva kho, āvuso, na cakkhu rūpānaṁ saṁyojanaṁ, na rūpā cakkhussa saṁyojanaṁ …pe…
verses.english: “In the same way, the eye is not the fetter of sights, nor are sights the fetter of the eye.

verses.pali: na jivhā …pe…
verses.english: The ear … nose … tongue … body …

verses.pali: na mano …pe…
verses.english: mind is not the fetter of ideas, nor are ideas the fetter of the mind.

verses.pali: yañca tattha tadubhayaṁ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṁ tattha saṁyojanan”ti.
verses.english: The fetter there is the desire and greed that arises from the pair of them.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
